page.overview:
Who is Eddie Baker?

Eddie Baker was a student at Haddonfield High School going into his senior year. He had dark hair and wore glases, and was a filmmaker who was doing a documentary on Smith's Grove Sanitarium. He put up ads, one of which was answered by his old crush, Christine Ray. His best friend, Maggie Grossman, had a big crush on him and tried to kiss him after they watched an X-Files episode together, but he told her he was not interested. She chose to act as if the incident never happened.

Eddie used to have a crush on Christine, but she barely noticed him. He was described as looking like a young David Duchovny. He and Christine eventually became a couple and were able to survive their encounter with Michael Myers at the sanitarium.
